answer: Re-attestations are stored in tide and ledge lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the inlet graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1460 impostors cost 692 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
